title: ID0422277-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R7 170002208] Technical Query
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Dear support I have a technical question if there is any list of the
supported OCPP parameters by the Sicharge D. After the huge
blackout in Spain and Portugal our CPO that uses Telefonica data
SIMs had a problem and they had all the chargers offline in the
backend. We could not help them in that moment. We would like to
help them to the future if they set parameter
AllowOfflineTxForUnknownId to TRUE and MaxEnergyOnInvalidId to
their own Wh limit.
My question is if the Sicharge D support these parameters. If there
is official document of the supported parameters I would be happy
to have it.
